data_description.statistics_target: shadow: the hourly statistics importer writes a separate statistic that nothing reads, alongside the existing statistics writers. live: the importer writes the Daily Usage sensor's own statistic and the existing writers are disabled. After switching to live, run the sync_statistics action from the oldest date you want rebuilt.

statistics_discontinuity.title: Water usage statistics failed verification
statistics_discontinuity.description: The hourly water-usage statistic `{statistic_id}` failed its consistency check at {hour}: {problem}. The next update re-syncs the affected range automatically; if this issue stays open, run the `sensus_analytics.sync_statistics` action from a date before {hour}.
